newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka's Hapugastenne sold at 242.25 mln rupees.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka's Hapugastenne sold at 242.25 mln rupees.

text.p: Sri Lanka on Tuesday sold a 51 percent stake in Hapugastenne Plantations Ltd at 242.25 million rupees as part of its plantation privatisation programme, brokers said.
The controlling interest, comprising 10.2 million shares, was sold to Plantation Management & Investment Co, at 23.75 rupees a 10-rupee share, they said.
The government has also said it will sell a 51 percent interest, or 10.2 million shares, in Balangoda Plantations, through the Colombo Stock Exchange. Bids are due to close on September 12.
A similar stake in another estate firm, Agarapatana Plantations, was sold at 35.25 rupees a share last week.
The government began privatising 23 plantation firms in late 1995.
Six estate firms, which have been privatised, are now traded on the bourse. The government expects to complete the privatisation of the plantation firms by the end of 1996.
